description: The self-transfer anti-buy proof (own-id excluded via excludeSet adding row.id) is genuinely tested and holds. BUT the SEED-address exclusion — half of the headline claim 'self/seed/treasury money cannot buy rank' — is proven only against a PLACEHOLDER. leaderboard-constants.js:10 sets SEED_ADDRESSES=['0x00000000000000000000000000000000000000a1'] with a TODO to fill the real treasury (0x810f...). The anti-buy test enrich.test.js:52 references SEED_ADDRESSES[0] DYNAMICALLY, so it passes for ANY value in the array and proves nothing about the real treasury being excluded. Shipping as-is: in production a genuine transfer FROM the real founder/treasury wallet (0x810f) would count as external inflow and DOES pump rank — the headline no-fake guarantee is FALSE until the constant is filled. OUR_INSTANCE_IDS is also [] (untested against a real instance id).
fix: Fill SEED_ADDRESSES with the real treasury/founder Base wallet(s) and OUR_INSTANCE_IDS with the canonical ids BEFORE any producer serves a leaderboard; test with a hard-coded real-looking seed addr, not SEED_ADDRESSES[0].
